name: White Plume Adventurer
clause: When ~ enters, you take the initiative.

needs.proposedSignature: Per-player state pl.ext.dungeon = { card: 'undercity' | 'lost-mine' | 'tomb' | 'dungeon-of-the-mad-mage'; room: string; completed: string[] } and pl.ext.hasInitiative, plus Effect { op: 'take-initiative' }, Effect { op: 'venture'; dungeon?: string }, Condition { kind: 'completed-dungeon'; who?: 'you' }, Condition { kind: 'has-initiative'; who }, TriggerEvent { on: 'initiative-taken'; who: 'you' | 'opponent' } and the three inherent initiative triggers of CR 726.2 as a step hook.
needs.semantics: 'You take the initiative' (CR 726.1) makes you the initiative player, ventures you into the Undercity, and installs the inherent triggers: at the beginning of your upkeep you venture again, and whenever an opponent deals combat damage to the initiative player they take it. Nothing in the vocabulary tracks a dungeon, a room, a venture marker, or the initiative designation, so both cards in this batch that print it are dead. 'If you've completed a dungeon' (White Plume Adventurer's second line) needs the same slice.
needs.clause: When ~ enters, you take the initiative.
